title: Abramelin, the hermit of Luxor in The Book of Abramelin

tellings.quote: Abramelon is essentially a uh, a desert hermit in Egypt around Luxor.

plain: Matthew Brown, a guest described on the podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, talks about The Book of Abramelin, an old book of magic. He describes Abramelin, the figure at its centre, as essentially a desert hermit living in Egypt around Luxor, and brings him up as part of an older tradition of contacting non-human beings.
